headline: Congress named a post office in Corpus Christi, Texas, after Captain Robert E. 'Bob' Batterson.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 802 North Tancahua Street in Corpus Christi, Texas. The building will be officially called the Captain Robert E. 'Bob' Batterson Post Office. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
